package.name: il_2d_multiscale_debug
package.description:
Deterministic 2D hierarchical expert debug harness.
Simulates a 5 Hz privileged macro expert (global truth ESDF, global route generation, left/right side selection from visible evidence) guiding a 30 Hz local expert (FOV ray-cast observation only, candidate trajectory search) for a planar vehicle, with a fixed-step (1/30 s) swept-collision simulator and a Qt5 Widgets interactive debug panel.
Information boundaries are enforced in the type system: the 30 Hz planner receives ONLY (VehicleState2D, LocalObservation, LocalTarget) and can never access the global ESDF, obstacle truth, or global paths.
This package produces NO training data; it is a pure 2D debugging and visualization case.
